tagline: LFO auto-panner and tremolo with stereo width control
description: A stereo effect that moves the left and right channel gains with a free-running LFO, using an equal-power gain law. The Phase Offset between the two channels decides the effect: at 0 the channels move in opposition for a left-right pan, and at the default 0.5 they rise and fall together, which sounds as a tremolo. A mid/side width control is applied before the movement.

features.name: Waveform
features.description: Sine, Triangle or Square LFO; the square switches hard between positions.

features.name: Rate and Depth
features.description: Rate from 0.01 to 20 Hz, not synced to tempo; Depth 0-1 sets how far the gains swing.

features.name: Phase Offset
features.description: Phase between the left and right LFOs from 0 to 1 cycle; 0 gives auto-pan and 0.5 gives tremolo.

features.name: Stereo Width
features.description: Scales the side signal from 0 (mono) to 2 (twice as wide) before panning.
